orig: Online long-distance courses
rev: Online courses
why: online 已交代授課方式；刪去 long-distance 可使名詞更精簡，原寫法並非嚴重文法錯誤。

orig: The clearest effect for me is saving travel time.
rev: For me, the clearest benefit is the time saved on commuting.
why: benefit 明示正面效果，commuting 比 travel 更精準地指往返學校。

orig: I think online courses should continue, but students need a regular study plan.
rev: Online courses should remain available, but students need a consistent study schedule.
why: 以 remain available 表達持續提供課程；study schedule 更具體對應時間安排。

orig: online long-distance courses
rev: online courses
why: 精簡授課形式的名稱，不影響原意。

orig: This change can reduce some pressure in student life.
rev: This flexibility can ease some of the pressure students face.
why: 明確指出 This 指的是 flexibility，避免概括的 change。

orig: Then several lessons become a large amount of work.
rev: As a result, several unfinished lessons can create an overwhelming workload.
why: 補明未完成課程與工作量的關係，讓結果更具體。

orig: online long-distance courses
rev: online courses
why: 省去重複的遠距概念。

orig: A student who needs to stay at home may still follow a lesson if the student feels well enough.
rev: Students who need to stay at home may still follow a lesson if they feel well enough.
why: 改成複數並以 they 承接，保留身體狀況許可的條件。

orig: A poor connection can make the teacher sound unclear,
rev: A poor connection can make it difficult to hear the teacher clearly,
why: 把網路問題造成的聽覺障礙寫得更直接。

orig: Online long-distance courses
rev: Online courses
why: 用較精簡且常見的名稱。

orig: The positive effect is a wider learning experience.
rev: One positive effect is access to a wider range of learning experiences.
why: One 避免暗示只有一項正面效果；range 使範圍增加的意思更清楚。

orig: we should not choose only because a title sounds exciting.
rev: we should not choose a course solely because its title sounds exciting.
why: 補出 course 使受詞明確；原句在上下文中仍可理解。

orig: Online long-distance courses
rev: Online courses
why: 簡化冗長名稱，不改變公平參與的主旨。

orig: One good effect is that location may become a smaller barrier to education.
rev: One benefit is that location may become less of a barrier to education.
why: less of a barrier 是更自然的搭配；保留 may 的審慎語氣。

orig: Schools should also consider lending equipment and offering places with reliable Internet.
rev: Schools should also consider lending equipment and providing study spaces with reliable Internet access.
why: study spaces 與 Internet access 更精準呈現支援措施。

orig: This makes me have mixed feelings about online long-distance courses.
rev: I therefore have mixed feelings about online courses.
why: 原句可以理解，但 makes me have 較迂迴；直接 have mixed feelings 更自然。

orig: Small online discussion groups can also help everyone have a turn.
rev: Small online discussion groups can also give everyone a chance to contribute.
why: contribute 明確指向提出想法，而不只輪流發言。

orig: I sometimes need extra time to organize my English,
rev: I sometimes need extra time to formulate my ideas in English,
why: organize my English 所指較模糊；改為用英文組織想法，語意較準確。

orig: a normal class
rev: a live class
why: normal 容易暗示錄影課不正常；live 更準確對比可暫停的錄影。

orig: Online long-distance courses are increasing because learning tools are convenient,
rev: Recorded online courses are becoming more common because learning tools are convenient,
why: 讓主張與下文錄影、暫停、重播的例子一致。

orig: The negative effect is that I may delay the work.
rev: One possible drawback is that I may put off the work.
why: possible 保留個人情境的可能性；put off 更直接表示拖延。

orig: Long-distance learning is useful for many subjects,
rev: Online learning is useful for many subjects,
why: 本文談網路授課，online 比 long-distance 更直接對應題目。

orig: For subjects based on reading and discussion, the effects can be positive.
rev: For courses centered on reading and discussion, online learning can be beneficial.
why: 把泛指的 effects 換成具體主詞；原句並非錯誤。

orig: These experiences are difficult to replace with a video.
rev: A video alone cannot easily replace these hands-on experiences.
why: alone 保留影片輔助的可能，hands-on 指明實作經驗。

orig: Students only need a suitable device and an Internet connection to access them.
rev: To access these videos, students need a suitable device and a reliable Internet connection.
why: only 容易低估設備與連線條件；保留取得影片的範圍，避免擴大到全部學習需求。

orig: Subtitles can become something I depend on too much.
rev: I may become too dependent on subtitles.
why: 用直接的主詞與搭配表達過度依賴。

orig: students still need to open their mouths and communicate.
rev: students still need to speak and interact with others.
why: 原句生動且可接受；修訂版較適合正式書面論述。

orig: Online long-distance courses
rev: Online courses
why: 精簡重複的課程名稱。

orig: One cause of the increase is the time needed to travel to school.
rev: One reason for this growth is the need to reduce commuting time.
why: 「需要減少通勤」比「通勤所需時間」更清楚表達採用線上課程的動機。

orig: But the saved time does not always lead to a better life.
rev: However, saving time does not always lead to healthier routines.
why: healthier routines 更直接銜接下文睡眠、活動與休息。
